title: A right adjoint whose counit is an isomorphism is fully faithful
statement: Let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor left adjoint to $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$, with counit $\varepsilon:L\circ R\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$. Assume that $\varepsilon_Y:LRY\to Y$ is an isomorphism for every object $Y$ of $\mathcal D$. Then $R$ is fully faithful: for all objects $Y,Y'$ of $\mathcal D$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(Y,Y')\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(RY,RY')$, $\psi\mapsto R\psi$, is bijective.

source.place: Categories, Lemma 07RB (lemma-adjoint-fully-faithful), part (2), direction 'epsilon is an isomorphism => v is fully faithful'
